ko.title: 다음 셧다운 절벽까지 7주: 의회가 9월 30일 미결 상태로 휴회에 진입

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: 의회는 2027 회계연도 예산안을 완료하지 못한 채 전통적인 8월 휴회를 위해 워싱턴을 떠났으며, 9월 30일 정부 자금 지급이 다시 중단되기 전에 합의에 도달할 수 있는 불과 7주를 남겨두었다.

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: 이번 휴회는 올해 초 국토안보부(DHS)의 기록적인 76일간의 부분 셧다운이 이민 집행, 국경 인력 배치, 그리고 관련 연방 서비스를 방해한 지 불과 몇 개월 후에 나타난다.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## 반복되는 익숙한 패턴

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: 매년 의회는 10월 1일에 새로운 회계연도가 시작되기 전에 연방 정부를 지원하기 위해 12개의 별도 예산 법안을 통과시켜야 한다.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: 현실적으로 의원들은 정기적으로 일정을 따라가지 못하며, 자금 지급 중단을 피하기 위해 임시 연장 결의안 또는 막판 종합 법안에 의존한다.

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: 올해도 그 익숙한 패턴을 따르고 있는 것으로 보인다. 현재 하원과 상원이 수주 동안 휴회 중이므로, 협상가들은 최종 기한이 다가오기 전에 두 의회 간의 상충하는 지출 우선순위를 조율할 수 있는 제한된 의회 회의 시간만 남겨두었다.

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: 의회 보좌관들은 현재의 교착 상태가 익숙한 쟁점들을 중심으로 한다고 설명한다 — 재량 지출의 전체 규모, 국경 보안 및 이민 집행 기관의 자금 수준, 그리고 개별 법안에 첨부된 정책 수정안.

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: 이러한 의견 불일치는 새로운 것이 아니지만, 지난번의 자금 지급 중단이 얼마나 방해가 되었는지를 고려할 때 올해는 특별한 중요성을 갖는다.

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## 지난 셧다운이 여전히 큰 문제인 이유

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: 올해 초, 특히 국토안보부에 영향을 미친 자금 지급 교착이 76일간 지속되어 그 기관의 역사상 가장 긴 셧다운이 되었다.

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: 지급 중단 기간 동안 수십만 명의 연방 직원들이 무급휴직하거나 무급으로 근무해야 했으며, 이민 법원과 사건 처리가 크게 둔화되었고, 자금이 결국 복구된 후에도 일상적인 기관 기능이 수주 동안 지연되었다.

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: 이러한 경험은 의회 지도자들과 연방 기관들 모두를 반복에 대해 경계하게 만들었다.

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: 기관 관계자들은 올해 평소보다 더 일찍 비상 계획을 시작했다고 알려졌으며, 일부 의원들은 또 다른 장기간의 중단 위험을 감수하지 않기 위해 9월 30일을 넘어 추가 협상 시간을 벌기 위한 단기 연장 결의안을 공개적으로 제안했다.

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: 그러나 그러한 임시방편이 양 의회를 통과할 수 있는지는 여전히 미지수이다. 연장 결의안 자체가 양당 지지를 필요로 하며 광범위한 예산 분쟁에서 때때로 협상 도구가 되었기 때문이다.

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## 휴회 후 어떤 일이 일어날까

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: 의원들이 9월에 워싱턴으로 돌아올 때, 회계연도가 끝나기 전에 불과 며칠의 의회 회의 일정만 남겨둘 것이다.

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: 의회 지도부는 전년도 종합 법안을 추진할지, 개별 예산 법안을 개별적으로 통과시킬지, 또는 협상이 계속되는 동안 중단을 방지하기 위해 다시 한 번 단기 연장 결의안에 의존할지 결정해야 한다.

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: 각 경로는 장단점이 있다. 급하게 추진된 종합 법안은 절차 문제로 비판받을 수 있고, 개별 법안은 개별적으로 통과시키는 데 시간이 많이 걸리며, 반복적인 단기 임시방편은 그 접근 방식이 연방 기관의 장기 계획을 어렵게 한다고 주장하는 양 당의 의원들로부터 불만을 받았다.

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## 연방 운영과 국민에게 미치는 영향

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: 자금 지급 중단은 정부의 모든 부분에 동등하게 영향을 미치지 않는다.

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: 현역 군사 작전, 항공 교통 관제, 법 집행과 같이 필수적이라고 간주되는 프로그램은 일반적으로 계속되지만, 직원들은 자금이 복구될 때까지 무급으로 남을 수 있다.

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: 기타 기능들 — 규제 검토, 허가 절차, 행정 서비스 포함 — 은 크게 둔화되거나 완전히 중단될 수 있다.

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: 연방 계약업체, 국립공원, 그리고 재량 자금에 크게 의존하는 기관들은 연장된 지급 중단 기간 동안 가장 눈에 띄게 영향을 받는 경우가 많다.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: 경제학자들과 예산 분석가들은 또한 반복된 셧다운 위협이 무급휴직 기간 자체를 넘어 비용을 초래한다고 지적했으며, 여기에는 지연된 연방 지급, 불확실성 기간 동안의 소비자 및 사업 신뢰도 저하, 그리고 기관 운영을 축소했다가 재개하는 데 드는 행정 비용이 포함된다.

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: 의회예산처(Congressional Budget Office)와 정부책임청(Government Accountability Office)은 모두 이전 셧다운 분석을 발행했으며, 자금이 복구된 후 수주 동안 지속될 수 있는 이러한 지속적인 영향을 강조했다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## 9월에 주목할 사항

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: 9월 30일 최종 기한이 다가옴에 따라, 주목할 주요 신호에는 예산 위원회가 휴회 종료 전에 업데이트된 법안 텍스트를 발표하는지 여부, 어느 한쪽 의회 지도부가 단기 연장 결의안에 대한 개방성을 드러내는지 여부, 그리고 백악관과 의회 지도자들이 초기 협상 입장을 어떻게 표현하는지 여부가 포함된다.

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: 이전 76일간의 셧다운으로 인한 파괴의 규모를 감안할 때, 양쪽 모두 반복을 피하려는 동기가 있다 — 그러나 여전히 해결되지 않은 동일한 근본적 불일치로 인해, 앞으로 몇 주간이 의회가 시간 제한 전에 행동할 수 있는지 여부를 결정할 것이다.

zh.title: 距下一次关闭悬崖仅七周：国会休会离席，9月30日问题未决

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: 国会已离开华盛顿进行传统的8月休会，未完成2027财政年度支出法案，仅给立法者七周时间在9月30日政府资金再次中断前达成协议。

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: 休会发生在仅几个月前国土安全部创纪录的76天部分停摆之后，该停摆扰乱了今年早些时候的移民执法行动、边境人员配置和相关联邦服务。

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## 熟悉的模式再现

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: 每年，国会应该在10月1日新财政年度开始前通过十二项独立拨款法案来为联邦政府提供资金。

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: 但在实践中，立法者经常落后于时间表，依赖临时继续拨款决议或临时性全面拨款方案来避免资金中断。

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: 今年似乎遵循了这一熟悉的模式：由于众议院和参议院现已休会数周，谈判者在截止日期到来前调和两院竞争支出优先事项的时间有限。

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: 国会工作人员将当前的僵局描述为围绕熟悉的症结——裁量支出的总体规模、边境安全和移民执法机构的资金水平，以及附加到各项法案的政策附加条款。

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: 虽然这些分歧并不新鲜，但鉴于上次资金中断造成的破坏程度，它们今年承担了额外的分量。

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## 为何上次停摆仍然影响深远

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: 今年早些时候，一场特别影响国土安全部的资金僵局持续了76天，成为该机构有史以来最长的停摆。

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: 在中断期间，数十万联邦雇员被强制休假或被要求无薪工作，移民法庭和案件处理速度显著放缓，在资金最终恢复后，常规机构功能又延迟了数周。

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: 这一经历使国会领导人和联邦机构都对重复发生感到警惕。

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: 据报道，机构官员今年已比通常情况下更早开始应急规划，一些立法者已公开提议短期继续拨款决议，以在9月30日后争取更多谈判时间，而不是冒再次长期中断的风险。

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: 然而，这样的临时措施是否能通过两院仍是悬而未决的问题，因为继续拨款决议本身需要两党支持，有时已成为更广泛资金争议中的讨价还价筹码。

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## 休会结束时将发生什么

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: 当立法者9月返回华盛顿时，他们在财政年度结束前仅有少数几个立法日。

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: 国会领导层需要决定是推动全年全面拨款方案、逐项通过各拨款法案，还是再次依赖短期继续拨款决议以在谈判继续进行时防止中断。

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: 每条路都有权衡：仓促的全面拨款可能招致程序批评，分项法案逐个通过费时，反复的短期补丁引起了两党成员的沮丧，他们主张这种做法使联邦机构难以进行长期规划。

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## 联邦运营和公众的利益

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: 资金中断对政府各部门的影响并不相等。

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: 被认为是必要的程序，如现役军事行动、空中交通管制和执法，通常会继续，尽管员工可能在资金恢复前不获报酬。

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: 其他功能——包括一些监管审查、许可流程和行政服务——可能会放缓或完全暂停。

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: 联邦承包商、国家公园和严重依赖裁量资金的机构在长期中断期间往往受影响最严重。

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: 经济学家和预算分析师也指出，反复的停摆威胁除了强制休假期本身外还会产生成本，包括延迟的联邦付款、不确定期间消费者和商业信心的下降，以及与机构运营关闭和重新启动相关的行政成本。

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: 国会预算办公室和政府问责办公室都发布了关于以往停摆的分析，突出了这些挥之不去的影响，这些影响可能在资金恢复后持续数周。

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## 9月应关注的事项

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: 随着9月30日截止日期逼近，关键的观察信号将包括拨款委员会是否在休会结束前发布更新的法案文本、任一院的领导层是否表示对短期继续拨款决议的开放态度，以及白宫和国会领导人如何描述其初始谈判立场。

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: 鉴于前次76天停摆造成的破坏规模，双方都有激励避免重复——但由于同样的基本分歧仍未解决，接下来的几周将决定国会是否能在时间耗尽前采取行动。

hi.title: अगले शटडाउन क्लिफ तक सात सप्ताह: कांग्रेस 30 सितंबर अनसुलझे के साथ अवकाश के लिए टूटती है

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: कांग्रेस वित्तीय वर्ष 2027 के खर्च विधेयकों को पूरा किए बिना अपने पारंपरिक अगस्त विश्राम के लिए वाशिंगटन छोड़ गई है, जिससे विधायकों को 30 सितंबर को सरकारी वित्त पोषण फिर से विफल होने से पहले एक समझौते पर पहुंचने के लिए केवल सात सप्ताह बचे हैं।

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: यह विश्राम इस साल की शुरुआत में होमलैंड सिक्योरिटी विभाग के एक रिकॉर्ड 76 दिन के आंशिक शटडाउन के कुछ महीने बाद आता है, जिसने आव्रजन प्रवर्तन संचालन, सीमा कर्मचारी, और संबंधित संघीय सेवाओं को बाधित किया था।

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## एक परिचित पैटर्न दोहराया जाता है

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: हर साल, कांग्रेस को 1 अक्टूबर को नए वित्तीय वर्ष की शुरुआत से पहले संघीय सरकार को वित्त पोषण करने के लिए बारह अलग-अलग अनुमोदन विधेयक पारित करने होते हैं।

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: व्यवहार में, विधायक नियमित रूप से अनुसूची से पीछे रह जाते हैं, वित्त पोषण में विराम से बचने के लिए अस्थायी जारी संकल्प या अंतिम समय के व्यापक पैकेज पर निर्भर रहते हैं।

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: इस साल भी उस परिचित पैटर्न का पालन कर रहा है: हाउस और सेनेट अब कई हफ्तों के लिए सत्र से बाहर हैं, वार्ताकारों के पास समय सीमा से पहले दोनों चैंबरों के बीच प्रतिस्पर्धी खर्च की प्राथमिकताओं को समन्वित करने के लिए सीमित मंजिल समय बचा है।

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: कांग्रेसी सहायक वर्तमान गतिरोध को परिचित अड़चनों के चारों ओर केंद्रित करते हुए वर्णित करते हैं — विवेकाधीन खर्च का समग्र आकार, सीमा सुरक्षा और आव्रजन प्रवर्तन एजेंसियों के लिए वित्त पोषण स्तर, और व्यक्तिगत विधेयकों से जुड़ी नीति राइडर्स।

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: ये सभी असहमतियां नई नहीं हैं, लेकिन वे इस साल अतिरिक्त वजन रखती हैं क्योंकि पिछला वित्त पोषण विराम कितना विघ्नकारी साबित हुआ।

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## पिछला शटडाउन अभी भी बड़ा क्यों दिखता है

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: इस साल की शुरुआत में, विशेष रूप से होमलैंड सिक्योरिटी विभाग को प्रभावित करने वाली एक वित्त पोषण गतिरोध 76 दिनों तक फैल गई, जो उस एजेंसी के लिए रिकॉर्ड पर सबसे लंबा शटडाउन बन गई।

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: विराम के दौरान, सैकड़ों हजार संघीय कर्मचारियों को अवकाश पर रखा गया या बिना वेतन के काम करने के लिए आवश्यक किया गया, आव्रजन अदालतों और मामले की प्रक्रिया में काफी कमी आई, और वित्त पोषण बहाल होने के बाद नियमित एजेंसी कार्यों में कई सप्ताह की देरी हुई।

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: इस अनुभव ने कांग्रेसी नेताओं और संघीय एजेंसियों दोनों को दोहराने से बचने के लिए सतर्क रखा है।

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: एजेंसी अधिकारियों ने इस साल सामान्य से पहले आकस्मिकता योजना शुरू की है, और कुछ विधायकों ने 30 सितंबर के बाद अतिरिक्त बातचीत के समय खरीदने के लिए एक अल्पकालीन जारी संकल्प का विचार सार्वजनिक रूप से प्रस्तुत किया है, बजाय एक और लंबे विराम के जोखिम के।

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: हालांकि, क्या ऐसा अस्थायी उपाय दोनों चैंबरों से गुजर सकता है, यह एक खुला प्रश्न बना हुआ है, क्योंकि जारी संकल्प स्वयं को द्विपक्षीय समर्थन की आवश्यकता होती है और कभी-कभी व्यापक वित्त पोषण विवादों में सौदेबाजी के चिप्स बन गए हैं।

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## जब विश्राम समाप्त होता है तो क्या होता है

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: जब विधायक सितंबर में वाशिंगटन लौटते हैं, तो वित्तीय वर्ष के अंत से पहले उनके पास केवल कुछ विधायी दिन होंगे।

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: कांग्रेसी नेतृत्व को यह तय करना होगा कि क्या एक पूर्ण वर्ष के व्यापक पैकेज के लिए धकेल दें, व्यक्तिगत अनुमोदन विधेयक को टुकड़े-टुकड़े में पारित करें, या बातचीत जारी रहने के दौरान विराम से बचने के लिए एक बार फिर से एक अल्पकालीन जारी संकल्प पर भरोसा करें।

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक पथ के अपने फायदे हैं: एक जल्दबाजी वाली व्यापक पैकेज प्रक्रिया पर आलोचना आमंत्रित कर सकती है, टुकड़े-टुकड़े वाले विधेयक व्यक्तिगत रूप से पारित करने के लिए समय लेने वाले हैं, और दोहराए गए अल्पकालीन पैच दोनों पार्टियों के सदस्यों से निराशा को आकर्षित किया है जो तर्क देते हैं कि यह दृष्टिकोण संघीय एजेंसियों के लिए दीर्घकालीन योजना को मुश्किल बनाता है।

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## संघीय संचालन और जनता के लिए दांव

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: एक वित्त पोषण विराम सरकार के हर हिस्से को समान रूप से प्रभावित नहीं करता है।

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: कार्यक्रम जिन्हें आवश्यक माना जाता है, जैसे सक्रिय-कर्तव्य सैन्य संचालन, वायु यातायात नियंत्रण, और कानून प्रवर्तन, आमतौर पर जारी रहता है, हालांकि कर्मचारियों को वित्त पोषण बहाल होने तक अवेतन रहना पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: अन्य कार्यों — कुछ नियामक समीक्षा, अनुमति प्रक्रिया, और प्रशासनिक सेवाएं सहित — धीमे या पूरी तरह से रुक सकते हैं।

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: संघीय ठेकेदार, राष्ट्रीय पार्क, और एजेंसियां जो विवेकाधीन वित्त पोषण पर बहुत अधिक निर्भर हैं, एक विस्तारित विराम के दौरान अक्सर सबसे अधिक दृष्टि से प्रभावित होते हैं।

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्रियों और बजट विश्लेषकों ने यह भी नोट किया है कि दोहराए गए शटडाउन धमकियां फ्यूर्लो अवधि से परे लागत लेती हैं, जिसमें देरी से संघीय भुगतान, अनिश्चितता की अवधि के दौरान कम उपभोक्ता और व्यावसायिक आत्मविश्वास, और एजेंसी संचालन को कम करने और पुनः शुरू करने से जुड़ी प्रशासनिक लागत शामिल है।

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: कांग्रेसी बजट कार्यालय और सरकार जवाबदेही कार्यालय दोनों ने पूर्व शटडाउन के विश्लेषण प्रकाशित किए हैं जो इन स्थायी प्रभावों को हाइलाइट करते हैं, जो वित्त पोषण बहाल होने के बाद हफ्तों तक बने रह सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## सितंबर में क्या देखें

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: जैसा कि 30 सितंबर की समय सीमा निकट आती है, देखने के लिए मुख्य संकेतों में यह शामिल होगा कि क्या अनुमोदन समितियां विश्राम समाप्त होने से पहले अद्यतन विधेयक पाठ जारी करती हैं, क्या किसी भी चैंबर में नेतृत्व एक अल्पकालीन जारी संकल्प के लिए खुलापन का संकेत देता है, और व्हाइट हाउस और कांग्रेसी नेताओं अपनी शुरुआती बातचीत की स्थिति को कैसे चित्रित करते हैं।

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: पूर्व 76 दिन के शटडाउन द्वारा होने वाले विघ्न के पैमाने को देखते हुए, दोनों पक्षों को दोहराने से बचने के लिए प्रोत्साहन हैं — लेकिन समान अंतर्निहित असहमतियों के साथ अभी भी अनसुलझी है, आने वाले हफ्तों यह तय करेंगे कि क्या कांग्रेस घड़ी फिर से समाप्त होने से पहले कार्य कर सकती है।

es.title: Siete Semanas Hasta el Próximo Abismo de Cierre: El Congreso se Toma un Receso con Septiembre 30 sin Resolver

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: El Congreso ha dejado Washington para su receso tradicional de agosto sin terminar los proyectos de ley de gastos del año fiscal 2027, dejando a los legisladores solo siete semanas para llegar a un acuerdo antes de que la financiación del gobierno vuelva a caducar el 30 de septiembre.

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: El receso llega solo meses después de un cierre parcial récord de 76 días en el Departamento de Seguridad Nacional que interrumpió las operaciones de cumplimiento de inmigración, la dotación de personal fronterizo y los servicios federales relacionados a principios de este año.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## Un Patrón Familiar se Repite

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: Cada año, se supone que el Congreso debe aprobar doce proyectos de ley de asignaciones separados para financiar al gobierno federal antes de que comience el nuevo año fiscal el 1 de octubre.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: En la práctica, los legisladores rutinariamente se atrasan en el cronograma, confiando en resoluciones continuas provisionales o paquetes ómnibus de último minuto para evitar una interrupción de la financiación.

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Este año parece estar siguiendo ese patrón familiar: con la Cámara y el Senado ahora fuera de sesión durante varias semanas, los negociadores tienen poco tiempo de sesión restante para reconciliar las prioridades de gasto en competencia entre las dos cámaras antes de que llegue la fecha límite.

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: Los asistentes del Congreso describen el punto muerto actual como centrado en puntos problemáticos familiares — el tamaño general del gasto discrecional, los niveles de financiación para las agencias de seguridad fronteriza y cumplimiento de inmigración, y los anexos de política adjuntos a proyectos de ley individuales.

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: Ninguno de estos desacuerdos es nuevo, pero tienen un peso adicional este año dada lo disruptivo que resultó la última interrupción de financiación.

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## Por Qué el Último Cierre Sigue Siendo una Gran Amenaza

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: A principios de este año, un impasse de financiación que afectaba específicamente al Departamento de Seguridad Nacional se extendió a 76 días, convirtiéndose en el cierre más largo registrado para esa agencia.

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: Durante la interrupción, cientos de miles de empleados federales fueron dados de baja o se les requirió trabajar sin pago, los tribunales de inmigración y el procesamiento de casos se ralentizaron significativamente, y las funciones de rutina de la agencia se retrasaron durante semanas después de que se restauró la financiación.

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: Esa experiencia ha dejado tanto a los líderes del Congreso como a las agencias federales desconfiados de una repetición.

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: Según informes, los funcionarios de la agencia han comenzado la planificación de contingencia antes de lo habitual este año, y algunos legisladores han planteado públicamente la idea de una resolución continua a corto plazo para ganar tiempo de negociación adicional después del 30 de septiembre, en lugar de arriesgar otra interrupción prolongada.

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: Sin embargo, si tal medida provisional puede pasar en ambas cámaras sigue siendo una pregunta abierta, ya que las resoluciones continuas en sí mismas requieren apoyo bipartidista y ocasionalmente se han convertido en fichas de negociación en disputas de financiación más amplias.

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## Qué Sucede Cuando Termina el Receso

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: Cuando los legisladores regresan a Washington en septiembre, tendrán solo un puñado de días legislativos antes de que termine el año fiscal.

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: El liderazgo del Congreso tendrá que decidir si presionar por un paquete ómnibus de año completo, aprobar proyectos de ley de asignaciones individuales de forma fragmentada, o confiar una vez más en una resolución continua a corto plazo para evitar una interrupción mientras continúan las conversaciones.

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: Cada camino tiene compensaciones: un ómnibus apresurado puede invitar críticas sobre el proceso, los proyectos de ley fragmentados son lentos de aprobar individualmente, y los parches repetitivos a corto plazo han generado frustración entre los miembros de ambos partidos que argumentan que el enfoque dificulta la planificación a largo plazo para las agencias federales.

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## Las Apuestas para Operaciones Federales y el Público

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: Una interrupción de financiación no afecta a todas las partes del gobierno por igual.

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: Los programas considerados esenciales, como las operaciones militares en servicio activo, el control del tráfico aéreo y el cumplimiento de la ley, típicamente continúan, aunque los empleados pueden quedarse sin pago hasta que se restaure la financiación.

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: Otras funciones — incluyendo algunas revisiones regulatorias, procesos de permisos y servicios administrativos — pueden ralentizarse o pausarse completamente.

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: Los contratistas federales, los parques nacionales y las agencias que dependen en gran medida de la financiación discrecional a menudo se encuentran entre los más visiblemente afectados durante una interrupción prolongada.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: Los economistas y analistas presupuestarios también han señalado que las amenazas de cierre repetido tienen costos más allá del período de baja en sí, incluyendo pagos federales retrasados, reducción de la confianza del consumidor y empresarial durante períodos de incertidumbre, y costos administrativos asociados con el cese y reinicio de operaciones de agencias.

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: La Oficina de Presupuesto del Congreso y la Oficina de Responsabilidad del Gobierno han publicado análisis de cierres anteriores destacando estos efectos persistentes, que pueden durar semanas después de que se restaure la financiación.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## Qué Observar en Septiembre

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: A medida que se acerca la fecha límite del 30 de septiembre, las señales clave a observar incluirán si los comités de asignaciones publican texto de proyectos de ley actualizado antes de que termine el receso, si el liderazgo en cualquiera de las cámaras señala apertura a una resolución continua a corto plazo, y cómo la Casa Blanca y los líderes del Congreso caracterizan sus posiciones negociadoras iniciales.

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: Dado el alcance de la disrupción causada por el cierre anterior de 76 días, ambos lados tienen incentivos para evitar una repetición — pero con los mismos desacuerdos subyacentes aún sin resolver, las próximas semanas determinarán si el Congreso puede actuar antes de que se agote el tiempo nuevamente.

ar.title: سبعة أسابيع حتى الجرف الحكومي القادم: الكونجرس يأخذ فترة راحة مع بقاء 30 سبتمبر دون حل

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: غادر الكونجرس واشنطن لعطلة أغسطس التقليدية دون إنهاء مشاريع الإنفاق للسنة المالية 2027، تاركاً المشرعين سبعة أسابيع فقط للتوصل إلى اتفاق قبل انقطاع التمويل الحكومي مرة أخرى في 30 سبتمبر.

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: تأتي العطلة بعد أشهر قليلة فقط من عطلة حكومية جزئية قياسية استمرت 76 يوماً في وزارة الأمن الداخلي، عطلت عمليات تطبيق الهجرة والعاملين على الحدود والخدمات الفيدرالية ذات الصلة في وقت سابق من هذا العام.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## نمط مألوف يتكرر

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: كل سنة، من المفترض أن يمرر الكونجرس اثني عشر مشروع قانون تخصيص منفصل لتمويل الحكومة الفيدرالية قبل بدء السنة المالية الجديدة في 1 أكتوبر.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: في الممارسة العملية، يتأخر المشرعون بشكل روتيني عن الجدول الزمني، معتمدين على قرارات استمرارية مؤقتة أو حزم شاملة من اللحظة الأخيرة لتجنب انقطاع التمويل.

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: يبدو أن هذا العام يتبع هذا النمط المألوف: مع خروج مجلس النواب والشيوخ من الجلسة لعدة أسابيع، لدى المفاوضين وقت محدود على أرضية المناقشة المتبقي لتوفيق أولويات الإنفاق المتنافسة بين المجلسين قبل حلول الموعد النهائي.

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: يصف مساعدو الكونجرس الجمود الحالي بأنه يركز على نقاط عالقة مألوفة — الحجم الإجمالي للإنفاق التقديري ومستويات التمويل لوكالات الأمن الحدودي وتطبيق الهجرة والفقرات السياسية المرفقة بمشاريع القوانين الفردية.

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: لا توجد أي من هذه الخلافات جديدة، لكنها تحمل وزناً إضافياً هذا العام نظراً لكم كان انقطاع التمويل الأخير مزعزعاً.

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## لماذا لا تزال العطلة الأخيرة تلوح بشكل كبير

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: في وقت سابق من هذا العام، امتد الجمود المالي الذي يؤثر بشكل خاص على وزارة الأمن الداخلي إلى 76 يوماً، ليصبح أطول عطلة حكومية مسجلة لتلك الوكالة.

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: خلال الانقطاع، تم إجازة مئات الآلاف من الموظفين الفيدراليين أو إجبارهم على العمل دون أجر، وتباطأت محاكم الهجرة ومعالجة الحالات بشكل كبير، وتأخرت الوظائف الروتينية للوكالة لأسابيع بعد استعادة التمويل في النهاية.

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: ترك هذا الخبر قادة الكونجرس والوكالات الفيدرالية حذرين من التكرار.

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: بدأ مسؤولو الوكالة على ما يبدو التخطيط للطوارئ في وقت أبكر من المعتاد هذا العام، وطرح بعض المشرعين علناً فكرة قرار استمراري قصير الأجل لشراء وقت تفاوضي إضافي بعد 30 سبتمبر، بدلاً من المخاطرة بانقطاع آخر طويل.

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: ما إذا كان يمكن لمثل هذا الحل المؤقت أن يمر عبر كلا المجلسين يبقى سؤالاً مفتوحاً، حيث أن القرارات الاستمرارية نفسها تتطلب دعماً ثنائي الحزب وأصبحت أحياناً رقائق مساومة في نزاعات تمويلية أوسع.

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## ماذا يحدث عندما تنتهي العطلة

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: عندما يعود المشرعون إلى واشنطن في سبتمبر، سيكون لديهم عدد قليل من الأيام التشريعية فقط قبل انتهاء السنة المالية.

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: ستحتاج القيادة الكونجرسية إلى الاختيار بين الدفع نحو حزمة شاملة لسنة كاملة وتمرير مشاريع قوانين التخصيص الفردية على دفعات أو الاعتماد مرة أخرى على قرار استمراري قصير الأجل لمنع انقطاع بينما تستمر المحادثات.

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: كل مسار يحمل مقاييس: حزمة شاملة مستعجلة يمكن أن تدعو إلى نقد حول العملية والمشاريع على دفعات تستغرق وقتاً طويلاً لتمريرها بشكل فردي والرقع قصيرة الأجل المتكررة أثارت الإحباط من الأعضاء في كلا الحزبين الذين يجادلون بأن هذا النهج يجعل التخطيط طويل الأجل صعباً على الوكالات الفيدرالية.

segments.tr: ## الرهانات في العمليات الفيدرالية والجمهور

segments.tr: انقطاع التمويل لا يؤثر على كل جزء من الحكومة بالتساوي.

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: تستمر البرامج التي تعتبر أساسية، مثل العمليات العسكرية النشطة والتحكم بحركة المرور الجوية وتطبيق القانون، عادة، على الرغم من أن الموظفين قد لا يحصلون على أجر حتى يتم استعادة التمويل.

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: قد تبطأ الوظائف الأخرى — بما في ذلك بعض المراجعات التنظيمية وعمليات الترخيص والخدمات الإدارية — أو توقف تماماً.

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: المقاولون الفيدراليون والحدائق الوطنية والوكالات التي تعتمد بشكل كبير على التمويل التقديري غالباً ما تكون من بين المتأثرين بشكل أكثر وضوحاً خلال انقطاع طويل.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: لاحظ الاقتصاديون ومحللو الميزانية أيضاً أن تهديدات الإغلاق المتكررة تحمل تكاليف تتجاوز فترة الإجازة نفسها، بما في ذلك تأخير المدفوعات الفيدرالية وتقليل ثقة المستهلكين والشركات خلال فترات عدم اليقين والتكاليف الإدارية المرتبطة بإيقاف وإعادة تشغيل عمليات الوكالة.

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: نشر مكتب الموازنة الكونجرسي ومكتب المساءلة الحكومي تحليلات لعمليات الإغلاق السابقة تسلط الضوء على هذه التأثيرات المستمرة، التي قد تستمر لأسابيع بعد استعادة التمويل.

segments.tr: ## ما يجب مراقبته في سبتمبر

segments.tr: مع اقتراب الموعد النهائي في 30 سبتمبر، ستشمل الإشارات الرئيسية التي يجب مراقبتها ما إذا كانت لجان التخصيص تصدر نصاً محدثاً للمشروع قبل انتهاء العطلة وما إذا كانت القيادة في أي من المجلسين تشير إلى الانفتاح على قرار استمراري قصير الأجل وكيف تميز البيت الأبيض وقادة الكونجرس مواقفهم التفاوضية الافتتاحية.
