segments.tr: بالنظر إلى حجم الاضطراب الناجم عن الإغلاق السابق الذي استمر 76 يوماً، لدى كلا الجانبين حوافز لتجنب التكرار — لكن مع بقاء الخلافات الأساسية دون حل، ستحدد الأسابيع القادمة ما إذا كان الكونجرس قادراً على التحرك قبل انتهاء الوقت مرة أخرى.

fr.title: Sept semaines jusqu'à la prochaine crise budgétaire : le Congrès en vacances avec le 30 septembre non résolu

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: Le Congrès a quitté Washington pour sa pause estivale traditionnelle sans terminer les projets de loi de crédit pour l'exercice fiscal 2027, laissant aux législateurs seulement sept semaines pour conclure un accord avant une nouvelle interruption du financement le 30 septembre.

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: La pause intervient quelques mois seulement après une fermeture partielle record de 76 jours au Département de la sécurité intérieure qui a perturbé les opérations d'application de la loi sur l'immigration, le personnel des frontières et les services fédéraux connexes plus tôt cette année.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## Un schéma familier se répète

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: Chaque année, le Congrès est censé adopter douze projets de loi de crédit distincts pour financer le gouvernement fédéral avant le début du nouvel exercice fiscal le 1er octobre.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: En pratique, les législateurs accumulent régulièrement du retard, s'appuyant sur des reconductions budgétaires provisoires ou des projets omnibus de dernière minute pour éviter une interruption du financement.

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Cette année semble suivre ce schéma familier : avec la Chambre et le Sénat désormais en repos depuis plusieurs semaines, les négociateurs ont peu de temps de débat restant pour réconcilier les priorités de dépenses concurrentes entre les deux chambres avant l'arrivée de la date limite.

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: Les adjoints du Congrès décrivent l'impasse actuelle comme portant sur des points de friction familiers — la taille globale des dépenses discrétionnaires, les niveaux de financement des agences de sécurité frontalière et d'application des lois sur l'immigration, et les dispositions politiques attachées aux projets de loi individuels.

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: Aucun de ces désaccords n'est nouveau, mais ils ont un poids supplémentaire cette année compte tenu du caractère perturbateur de la dernière interruption du financement.

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la dernière fermeture continue de peser lourdement

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: Plus tôt cette année, une impasse de financement affectant spécifiquement le Département de la sécurité intérieure s'est étendue sur 76 jours, devenant la fermeture la plus longue jamais enregistrée pour cette agence.

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: Pendant l'interruption, des centaines de milliers d'employés fédéraux ont été mis en congé ou tenus de travailler sans rémunération, les tribunaux de l'immigration et le traitement des dossiers ont ralenti considérablement, et les fonctions courantes des agences ont été retardées pendant des semaines après le rétablissement du financement.

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: Cette expérience a laissé les dirigeants du Congrès et les agences fédérales méfiants d'une répétition.

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: Les responsables des agences ont apparemment commencé la planification d'urgence plus tôt que d'habitude cette année, et certains législateurs ont publiquement évoqué l'idée d'une reconduction budgétaire à court terme pour acheter du temps de négociation supplémentaire au-delà du 30 septembre, plutôt que de risquer une autre interruption prolongée.

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: Que ce type de mesure provisoire puisse passer par les deux chambres reste cependant une question ouverte, car les reconductions budgétaires elles-mêmes nécessitent un soutien bipartite et sont devenues occasionnellement des éléments d'échange dans des différends plus larges sur le financement.

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## Que se passe-t-il quand la pause prend fin

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: Quand les législateurs reviennent à Washington en septembre, ils n'auront que quelques jours législatifs avant la fin de l'exercice fiscal.

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: La direction du Congrès devra décider s'il faut pousser pour un paquet omnibus d'un an, adopter les projets de loi de crédit individuels au coup par coup, ou s'appuyer à nouveau sur une reconduction budgétaire à court terme pour prévenir une interruption pendant que les pourparlers continuent.

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: Chaque approche comporte des compromis : un omnibus précipité peut susciter des critiques sur le processus, les projets au coup par coup prennent du temps à adopter individuellement, et les correctifs à court terme répétés ont suscité la frustration des membres des deux partis qui soutiennent que cette approche rend la planification à long terme difficile pour les agences fédérales.

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## Les enjeux pour les opérations fédérales et le public

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: Une interruption du financement n'affecte pas toutes les parties du gouvernement de la même manière.

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: Les programmes considérés comme essentiels, tels que les opérations militaires en service actif, le contrôle du trafic aérien et l'application de la loi, continuent généralement, bien que les employés puissent ne pas être rémunérés jusqu'au rétablissement du financement.

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: D'autres fonctions — y compris certains examens réglementaires, les processus de permis et les services administratifs — peuvent ralentir ou s'arrêter complètement.

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: Les entrepreneurs fédéraux, les parcs nationaux et les agences qui dépendent fortement du financement discrétionnaire sont souvent parmi les plus visiblement affectés pendant une interruption prolongée.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: Les économistes et les analystes budgétaires ont également noté que les menaces de fermeture répétées entraînent des coûts au-delà de la période de congé elle-même, y compris les retards dans les paiements fédéraux, la confiance réduite des consommateurs et des entreprises pendant les périodes d'incertitude, et les coûts administratifs associés à la fermeture et au redémarrage des opérations des agences.

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: Le Bureau du budget du Congrès et le Bureau de la responsabilité du gouvernement ont tous deux publié des analyses des fermetures antérieures mettant en évidence ces effets persistants, qui peuvent durer des semaines après le rétablissement du financement.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## Ce à surveiller en septembre

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: À l'approche de la date limite du 30 septembre, les signaux clés à surveiller comprendront si les commissions des crédits publient un texte de projet de loi mis à jour avant la fin de la pause, si la direction de l'une ou l'autre chambre signale l'ouverture à une reconduction budgétaire à court terme, et comment la Maison-Blanche et les dirigeants du Congrès caractérisent leurs positions de négociation d'ouverture.

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: Compte tenu de l'ampleur de la perturbation causée par la fermeture précédente de 76 jours, les deux côtés ont des incitations à éviter une répétition — mais avec les mêmes désaccords sous-jacents toujours non résolus, les semaines à venir détermineront si le Congrès peut agir avant que le temps s'écoule à nouveau.

pt.title: Sete Semanas Até o Próximo Precipício de Desligamento: Congresso Entra em Recesso Com 30 de Setembro Sem Resolução

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: O Congresso deixou Washington em seu recesso tradicional de agosto sem terminar os projetos de lei de gastos do ano fiscal de 2027, deixando os legisladores com apenas sete semanas para chegar a um acordo antes que o financiamento do governo expire novamente em 30 de setembro.

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: O recesso chega apenas alguns meses após um recorde de desligamento parcial de 76 dias no Departamento de Segurança Interna que perturbou as operações de aplicação da imigração, equipes de fronteira e serviços federais relacionados no início deste ano.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## Um Padrão Familiar Se Repete

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: A cada ano, o Congresso deve aprovar doze projetos de lei de apropriações separados para financiar o governo federal antes do novo ano fiscal começar em 1º de outubro.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: Na prática, os legisladores rotineiramente ficam atrasados, contando com resoluções continuadas provisórias ou pacotes omnibus de último minuto para evitar uma interrupção no financiamento.

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Este ano parece estar seguindo esse padrão familiar: com a Câmara e o Senado agora em recesso por várias semanas, os negociadores têm tempo limitado em plenário para reconciliar as prioridades de gastos concorrentes entre as duas câmaras antes da chegada do prazo.

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: Assistentes do Congresso descrevem o impasse atual como centrado em pontos de impasse familiares — o tamanho geral dos gastos discricionários, níveis de financiamento para agências de segurança de fronteira e aplicação da imigração, e cláusulas de política anexadas a projetos de lei individuais.

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: Nenhum desses desacordos é novo, mas eles carregam peso extra este ano dado o quão perturbador a última interrupção de financiamento se mostrou ser.

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## Por Que o Último Desligamento Continua Sendo Ameaçador

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: No início deste ano, um impasse de financiamento especificamente afetando o Departamento de Segurança Interna se estendeu por 76 dias, tornando-se o desligamento mais longo registrado para essa agência.

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: Durante a interrupção, centenas de milhares de funcionários federais foram dispensados ou obrigados a trabalhar sem pagamento, tribunais de imigração e processamento de casos desaceleraram significativamente, e funções rotineiras da agência foram atrasadas por semanas após o financiamento ser finalmente restaurado.

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: Essa experiência deixou tanto os líderes do Congresso quanto as agências federais cautelosos quanto a uma repetição.

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: Funcionários da agência teriam começado planejamento de contingência mais cedo que o usual este ano, e alguns legisladores apresentaram publicamente a ideia de uma resolução continuada de curto prazo para comprar tempo adicional de negociação após 30 de setembro, em vez de arriscar outra interrupção prolongada.

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: Se tal medida de emergência pode passar em ambas as câmaras, no entanto, permanece uma questão aberta, já que as resoluções continuadas elas mesmas requerem apoio bipartidário e ocasionalmente se tornaram moedas de troca em disputas de financiamento mais amplas.

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## O Que Acontece Quando o Recesso Termina

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: Quando os legisladores retornarem a Washington em setembro, eles terão apenas poucos dias legislativos antes do ano fiscal terminar.

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: A liderança do Congresso precisará decidir se deve pressionar por um pacote omnibus de ano inteiro, passar projetos de lei de apropriações individuais gradualmente, ou contar novamente com uma resolução continuada de curto prazo para evitar uma interrupção enquanto as conversas continuam.

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: Cada caminho carrega trade-offs: um omnibus apressado pode convidar críticas sobre o processo, projetos de lei individuais demoram para ser aprovados um a um, e remendos de curto prazo repetidos atraíram frustração de membros em ambos os partidos que argumentam que a abordagem torna o planejamento de longo prazo difícil para agências federais.

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## Os Riscos para Operações Federais e o Público

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: Uma interrupção de financiamento não afeta cada parte do governo igualmente.

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: Programas considerados essenciais, como operações militares em serviço ativo, controle de tráfego aéreo e aplicação da lei, típicamente continuam, embora funcionários possam não ser pagos até que o financiamento seja restaurado.

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: Outras funções — incluindo algumas revisões regulatórias, processos de permissão e serviços administrativos — podem desacelerar ou pausar inteiramente.

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: Contratistas federais, parques nacionais e agências que dependem pesadamente de financiamento discricionário são frequentemente entre os mais visivelmente afetados durante uma interrupção estendida.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: Economistas e analistas de orçamento também notaram que ameaças repetidas de desligamento carregam custos além do período de licença em si, incluindo pagamentos federais atrasados, confiança reduzida do consumidor e das empresas durante períodos de incerteza, e custos administrativos associados ao encerramento e reinício de operações da agência.

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: O Escritório de Orçamento do Congresso e o Escritório de Responsabilidade do Governo ambos publicaram análises de desligamentos anteriores destacando esses efeitos persistentes, que podem persistir por semanas após o financiamento ser restaurado.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## O Que Acompanhar em Setembro

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Conforme o prazo de 30 de setembro se aproxima, sinais-chave para acompanhar incluirão se comitês de apropriações lançam texto de projeto de lei atualizado antes do recesso terminar, se a liderança em qualquer câmara sinaliza abertura para uma resolução continuada de curto prazo, e como a Casa Branca e líderes do Congresso caracterizam suas posições de negociação inicial.

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: Dada a magnitude da perturbação causada pelo desligamento anterior de 76 dias, ambos os lados têm incentivos para evitar uma repetição — mas com os mesmos desacordos subjacentes ainda não resolvidos, as próximas semanas determinarão se o Congresso pode agir antes do relógio expirar novamente.

in.title: Tujuh Minggu Menjelang Krisis Penutupan Berikutnya: Kongres Libur Rehat dengan Masalah 30 September Belum Terselesaikan

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: Kongres telah meninggalkan Washington untuk libur Agustus tradisionalnya tanpa menyelesaikan RUU pengeluaran tahun anggaran 2027, meninggalkan pembuat undang-undang hanya tujuh minggu untuk mencapai kesepakatan sebelum pendanaan pemerintah terputus lagi pada 30 September.

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: Libur ini datang hanya beberapa bulan setelah penutupan parsial 76 hari rekor di Departemen Keamanan Dalam Negeri mengganggu operasi penegakan imigrasi, staf perbatasan, dan layanan federal terkait di awal tahun ini.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## Pola Familiar Berulang

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: Setiap tahun, Kongres seharusnya meloloskan dua belas RUU alokasi anggaran terpisah untuk mendanai pemerintah federal sebelum tahun anggaran baru dimulai pada 1 Oktober.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: Dalam praktik, pembuat undang-undang secara rutin tertinggal jadwal, mengandalkan resolusi berkelanjutan sementara atau paket omnibus menit terakhir untuk menghindari terputusnya pendanaan.

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Tahun ini tampaknya mengikuti pola familiar itu: dengan Dewan Perwakilan dan Senat sekarang tidak dalam sesi selama beberapa minggu, negosiator memiliki waktu lantai terbatas untuk menyelaraskan prioritas pengeluaran yang bersaing antara dua kamar sebelum tenggat waktu tiba.

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: Staf Kongres menggambarkan kebuntuan saat ini berpusat pada titik-titik hambat yang familiar — ukuran keseluruhan pengeluaran diskresi, tingkat pendanaan untuk badan keamanan perbatasan dan penegakan imigrasi, dan pengendara kebijakan yang dilampirkan pada RUU individual.

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: Tidak ada satu pun dari perselisihan ini yang baru, tetapi mereka membawa bobot ekstra tahun ini mengingat betapa mengganggu terputusnya pendanaan terakhir itu ternyata.

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Penutupan Terakhir Masih Menonjol

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: Di awal tahun ini, kebuntuan pendanaan yang secara khusus mempengaruhi Departemen Keamanan Dalam Negeri merentang hingga 76 hari, menjadi penutupan terlama yang pernah tercatat untuk agensi itu.

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: Selama terputusnya pendanaan, ratusan ribu pegawai federal dicuti tanpa bayar atau diminta bekerja tanpa bayar, pengadilan imigrasi dan pemrosesan kasus melambat secara signifikan, dan fungsi agensi rutin tertunda selama berminggu-minggu setelah pendanaan akhirnya dipulihkan.

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: Pengalaman itu telah membuat para pemimpin Kongres dan agensi federal waspada terhadap pengulangan.

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: Pejabat agensi dilaporkan telah memulai perencanaan kontingensi lebih awal dari biasanya tahun ini, dan beberapa pembuat undang-undang telah secara terbuka mengajukan ide resolusi berkelanjutan jangka pendek untuk membeli waktu negosiasi tambahan setelah 30 September, daripada berisiko terputusnya pendanaan yang diperpanjang lagi.

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: Apakah perbaikan sementara seperti itu dapat meloloskan kedua kamar, bagaimanapun, tetap menjadi pertanyaan terbuka, karena resolusi berkelanjutan sendiri memerlukan dukungan bipartisan dan kadang-kadang menjadi kartu tawar-menawar dalam perselisihan pendanaan yang lebih luas.

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Terjadi Ketika Rehat Berakhir

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: Ketika pembuat undang-undang kembali ke Washington di September, mereka akan memiliki hanya segelintir hari legislatif sebelum tahun anggaran berakhir.

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: Kepemimpinan Kongres perlu memutuskan apakah akan mendorong paket omnibus tahun penuh, meloloskan RUU alokasi anggaran individual secara bertahap, atau mengandalkan sekali lagi resolusi berkelanjutan jangka pendek untuk mencegah terputusnya pendanaan sambil pembicaraan berlanjut.

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: Setiap jalur membawa kompromi: omnibus terburu-buru dapat mengundang kritik atas proses, RUU bertahap memakan waktu untuk diloloskan secara individual, dan tambalan jangka pendek berulang telah menarik frustrasi dari anggota di kedua belah pihak yang berpendapat pendekatan itu membuat perencanaan jangka panjang sulit bagi agensi federal.

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## Taruhannya untuk Operasi Federal dan Masyarakat

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: Terputusnya pendanaan tidak mempengaruhi setiap bagian pemerintah secara merata.

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: Program yang dianggap penting, seperti operasi militer aktif, kontrol lalu lintas udara, dan penegakan hukum, biasanya berlanjut, meskipun karyawan mungkin tidak dibayar sampai pendanaan dipulihkan.

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: Fungsi lain — termasuk beberapa tinjauan regulasi, proses perizinan, dan layanan administratif — dapat melambat atau berhenti sepenuhnya.

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: Kontraktor federal, taman nasional, dan agensi yang sangat mengandalkan pendanaan diskresi sering kali termasuk yang paling terlihat terkena dampak selama terputusnya pendanaan yang diperpanjang.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: Ekonom dan analis anggaran juga telah mencatat bahwa ancaman penutupan berulang membawa biaya di luar periode cuti tanpa bayar itu sendiri, termasuk pembayaran federal tertunda, kepercayaan konsumen dan bisnis berkurang selama periode ketidakpastian, dan biaya administratif yang terkait dengan menutup dan memulai kembali operasi agensi.

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: Kantor Anggaran Kongres dan Kantor Akuntabilitas Pemerintah telah menerbitkan analisis penutupan sebelumnya yang menyoroti efek tertinggal ini, yang dapat bertahan selama berminggu-minggu setelah pendanaan dipulihkan.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan di September

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Saat tenggat waktu 30 September mendekati, sinyal kunci yang perlu diperhatikan akan mencakup apakah komite alokasi anggaran merilis teks RUU yang diperbarui sebelum rehat berakhir, apakah kepemimpinan di salah satu kamar menandakan keterbukaan terhadap resolusi berkelanjutan jangka pendek, dan bagaimana Gedung Putih dan pemimpin Kongres mencirikan posisi negosiasi pembukaan mereka.

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: Mengingat skala gangguan yang disebabkan oleh penutupan 76 hari sebelumnya, kedua belah pihak memiliki insentif untuk menghindari pengulangan — tetapi dengan perselisihan mendasar yang sama masih belum terselesaikan, minggu-minggu mendatang akan menentukan apakah Kongres dapat bertindak sebelum waktu habis lagi.

segments.tr: 今年初め、国土安全保障省に特に影響する資金面での行き詰まりが76日間に及び、その機関における過去最長の政府閉鎖となった。

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: この期間中、数十万の連邦職員が休職させられるか無給での勤務を強いられ、移民裁判所と事件処理が著しく遅延し、資金が最終的に復旧した後も通常の機関機能が数週間遅延した。

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: この経験は、議会指導者と連邦機関の両方に繰り返しを警戒させている。

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: 機関当局者たちは今年いつもより早く応急計画を開始したと報告されており、一部の議員たちは別の長期的な資金途絶のリスクを冒すのではなく、9月30日を超えた追加の交渉時間を確保するための短期つなぎ予算案の考えを公に提案している。

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: しかし、そのようなつなぎ予算案が両議会を通過できるかどうかは開かれた問題のままであり、つなぎ予算案自体が党派を超えたサポートを必要とし、時には広範な予算争いでの交渉材料となってきた。

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## 休会が終わったときに何が起こるか

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: 議員たちが9月にワシントンに戻ったとき、会計年度が終わる前にほんの数日の立法日しか残されていないだろう。

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: 議会指導部は、通年の全包括的な法案を推し進めるか、個別の予算案を段階的に可決するか、または交渉が続く中で資金途絶を防ぐために再び短期つなぎ予算案に頼るかを決定する必要があるだろう。

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: 各選択肢にはトレードオフが伴う。急ぎ立てられた全包括的な法案はプロセスに対する批判を招く可能性があり、段階的な法案は個別に可決するのに時間がかかり、繰り返される短期的な修正は、その方法が連邦機関による長期計画を困難にしていると主張する両党の議員からの不満を招いている。

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## 連邦政府運営と国民にとってのリスク

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: 資金途絶は政府のすべての部分に等しく影響しない。

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: 現役軍事作戦、航空交通管制、法執行機関などの必須と判断されるプログラムは通常継続されるが、資金が復旧されるまで職員は無給となる可能性がある。

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: 規制審査、許可申請プロセス、行政サービスなど、その他の機能は遅延するか完全に停止する可能性がある。

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: 連邦契約業者、国立公園、および裁量資金に大きく依存する機関は、長期的な資金途絶期間中に最も顕著に影響を受けることが多い。

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: 経済学者と予算分析家は、政府閉鎖の脅威の繰り返しが休職期間そのもの以上のコストをもたらすことも指摘しており、これには遅延した連邦支払い、不確実性の期間中の消費者および企業の信頼の低下、および機関業務の縮小と再開に関連する行政コストが含まれる。

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: 議会予算局と政府説明責任局は、これらの継続的な影響を強調した過去の政府閉鎖の分析を発表しており、これらは資金が復旧した後も数週間続く可能性がある。

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## 9月に注視すべきこと

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: 9月30日の期限が近づくにつれ、注視すべき主要な兆候には、予算委員会が休会終了前に更新された法案テキストを発表するかどうか、いずれかの議会の指導部が短期つなぎ予算案に対する開放性を示すかどうか、およびホワイトハウスと議会指導者が初期交渉立場をどのように特徴付けるかが含まれるだろう。

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: 前回の76日間の政府閉鎖によって引き起こされた混乱の規模を考えると、双方は繰り返しを避けるインセンティブを持っているが、同じ根本的な意見の相違がまだ解決されていないため、今後数週間は議会が再び時間切れになる前に行動できるかどうかを決定するだろう。

de.title: Sieben Wochen bis zur nächsten Haushaltsabschaltung: Kongress macht Pause, September 30 bleibt ungeklärt

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: Der Kongress hat Washington für seine traditionelle Augustpause verlassen, ohne die Ausgabengesetze für das Haushaltsjahr 2027 zu beenden, und hinterlässt den Gesetzgebern nur sieben Wochen Zeit, um eine Einigung zu erzielen, bevor die Staatsfinanzierung am 30. September erneut ausläuft.

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: Die Pause folgt nur wenige Monate nach einer Rekord-76-Tage-Teilabschaltung des Department of Homeland Security, die Operationen der Einwanderungsdurchsetzung, Grenzstaffeln und verwandte Bundesdienstleistungen früher in diesem Jahr unterbrachen.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## Ein vertrautes Muster wiederholt sich

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: Jedes Jahr sollte der Kongress zwölf separate Bewilligungsgesetze verabschieden, um die Bundesregierung zu finanzieren, bevor das neue Haushaltsjahr am 1. Oktober beginnt.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: In der Praxis bleiben die Gesetzgeber routinemäßig hinter dem Zeitplan zurück und verlassen sich auf provisorische Übergangsresolutionen oder in letzter Minute zusammengestellte Omnibus-Pakete, um eine Finanzierungslücke zu vermeiden.

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Dieses Jahr scheint diesem vertrauten Muster zu folgen: Da das Repräsentantenhaus und der Senat nun mehrere Wochen lang nicht in Sitzung sind, bleibt den Verhandlungsführern nur begrenzte Zeit, um die konkurrierenden Haushaltsprioräten zwischen den beiden Kammern vor dem Stichtag zu vereinbaren.

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: Kongressmitarbeiter beschreiben die derzeitige Sackgasse als Konzentration auf bekannte Streitpunkte – die Gesamtgröße der Ermessensausgaben, Finanzierungssätze für Grenzschutz- und Einwanderungsbehörden sowie Zusatzbestimmungen, die an einzelne Gesetzesentwürfe angebracht sind.

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: Keine dieser Meinungsverschiedenheiten sind neu, aber sie haben dieses Jahr zusätzliches Gewicht angesichts dessen, wie störend sich die letzte Finanzierungslücke erwies.

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## Warum die letzte Abschaltung immer noch bedeutsam ist

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: Anfang dieses Jahres wurde ein Finanzierungsdeadlock, der speziell das Department of Homeland Security betraf, auf 76 Tage ausgedehnt und wurde zur längsten Abschaltung aller Zeiten für diese Behörde.

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: Während der Lücke wurden Hunderttausende von Bundesbediensteten in unbezahlten Urlaub versetzt oder mussten ohne Bezahlung arbeiten, Einwanderungsgerichte und die Fallbearbeitung verlangsamt sich erheblich, und Routinefunktionen der Behörden wurden Wochen nach der Wiederherstellung der Finanzierung verzögert.

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: Dieses Erlebnis hat Kongressführer und Bundesbehörden gegenüber einer Wiederholung skeptisch gestimmt.

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: Beamte der Behörden haben Berichten zufolge dieses Jahr früher als üblich mit der Notfallplanung begonnen, und einige Gesetzgeber haben öffentlich die Idee einer kurzfristigen Übergangsresolution vorgeschlagen, um zusätzliche Verhandlungszeit nach dem 30. September zu gewinnen, anstatt das Risiko einer weiteren verlängerten Lücke einzugehen.

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: Ob jedoch eine solche Übergangslösung beide Kammern passieren kann, bleibt eine offene Frage, da Übergangsresolutionen selbst bipartisane Unterstützung erfordern und gelegentlich zu Verhandlungsmitteln in breiteren Finanzierungsstreitigkeiten geworden sind.

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## Was passiert, wenn die Pause endet

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: Wenn die Gesetzgeber im September nach Washington zurückkehren, werden sie nur eine Handvoll Gesetzgebungstage haben, bevor das Haushaltsjahr endet.

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: Die Kongressleitung muss entscheiden, ob sie auf ein Omnibus-Paket für das ganze Jahr drängen wird, einzelne Bewilligungsgesetze nacheinander verabschieden wird, oder sich erneut auf eine kurzfristige Übergangsresolution verlässt, um eine Lücke zu verhindern, während die Gespräche fortgesetzt werden.

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: Jeder Weg mit sich Kompromisse: Ein eiliger Omnibus kann Kritik am Verfahren auslösen, einzelne Gesetzesentwürfe sind zeitaufwändig, einzeln zu verabschieden, und wiederholte kurzfristige Übergangslösungen haben Frustration bei Mitgliedern beider Parteien ausgelöst, die argumentieren, dass dieser Ansatz eine langfristige Planung für Bundesbehörden schwierig macht.

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## Die Einsätze für Bundesoperationen und die Öffentlichkeit

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: Eine Finanzierungslücke beeinträchtigt nicht alle Teile der Regierung gleich.

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: Programme, die als wesentlich angesehen werden, wie aktive Militäroperationen, Flugsicherung und Strafverfolgung, werden normalerweise fortgesetzt, obwohl Arbeitnehmer möglicherweise bis zur Wiederherstellung der Finanzierung unbezahlt bleiben.

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: Andere Funktionen – einschließlich einiger behördlicher Überprüfungen, Genehmigungsverfahren und Verwaltungsdienste – können verlangsamt werden oder ganz zum Stillstand kommen.

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: Bundesauftragnehmer, Nationalparks und Behörden, die stark auf Ermessensausgaben angewiesen sind, sind während einer verlängerten Lücke oft am sichtbarsten betroffen.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: Wirtschaftler und Haushaltsanalysten haben auch angemerkt, dass wiederholte Abschaltungsdrohungen Kosten über den Beurlaubungszeitraum hinaus tragen, einschließlich verzögerter Bundeszahlungen, verringertem Vertrauen von Verbrauchern und Unternehmen in Zeiten der Unsicherheit und Verwaltungskosten im Zusammenhang mit der Stilllegung und dem Neustart von Behördenbetrieben.

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: Das Congressional Budget Office und das Government Accountability Office haben beide Analysen früherer Abschaltungen veröffentlicht, die diese anhaltenden Auswirkungen hervorheben, die Wochen nach der Wiederherstellung der Finanzierung anhalten können.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## Was im September zu beobachten ist

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Wenn sich die Frist vom 30. September nähert, werden wichtige Signale, die zu beobachten sind, einschließen, ob die Haushaltsausschüsse aktualisierten Gesetzesentwurftext vor Ende der Pause veröffentlichen, ob Führungspersonen einer Kammer Aufgeschlossenheit gegenüber einer kurzfristigen Übergangsresolution signalisieren, und wie das Weiße Haus und Kongressführer ihre anfängliche Verhandlungsposition charakterisieren.

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: Angesichts des Ausmaßes der Störung durch die frühere 76-Tage-Abschaltung haben beide Seiten Anreize, eine Wiederholung zu vermeiden – aber mit den gleichen zugrunde liegenden Meinungsverschiedenheiten, die immer noch ungeklärt sind, werden die kommenden Wochen entscheiden, ob der Kongress handeln kann, bevor die Zeit wieder abläuft.

vi.title: Bảy Tuần Cho Đến Vách Đổ Tiếp Theo: Quốc Hội Nghỉ Hè Với Ngày 30 Tháng 9 Vẫn Chưa Giải Quyết

segments.src: Congress has left Washington for its traditional August recess without finishing the fiscal year 2027 spending bills, leaving lawmakers just seven weeks to strike a deal before government funding lapses again on September 30.
segments.tr: Quốc Hội đã rời khỏi Washington để nghỉ hè tháng 8 truyền thống mà chưa hoàn thành các dự luật chi tiêu năm tài khóa 2027, để lại cho các nhà lập pháp chỉ bảy tuần để đạt được thỏa thuận trước khi tài trợ chính phủ lại bị gián đoạn vào ngày 30 tháng 9.

segments.src: The recess comes only months after a record 76-day partial shutdown at the Department of Homeland Security disrupted immigration enforcement operations, border staffing, and related federal services earlier this year.
segments.tr: Kỳ nghỉ này diễn ra chỉ vài tháng sau một đợt tắt cửa một phần kéo dài 76 ngày kỷ lục tại Bộ An ninh Nội địa đã làm gián đoạn các hoạt động thực thi nhập cư, nhân sự biên giới và các dịch vụ liên bang có liên quan vào đầu năm nay.

segments.src: ## A Familiar Pattern Repeats
segments.tr: ## Một Mô Hình Quen Thuộc Lặp Lại

segments.src: Every year, Congress is supposed to pass twelve separate appropriations bills to fund the federal government before the new fiscal year begins on October 1.
segments.tr: Mỗi năm, Quốc Hội được giả định là phải thông qua mười hai dự luật bổ sung cấp kinh phí riêng biệt để tài trợ cho chính phủ liên bang trước khi năm tài khóa mới bắt đầu vào ngày 1 tháng 10.

segments.src: In practice, lawmakers routinely fall behind schedule, relying on stopgap continuing resolutions or last-minute omnibus packages to avoid a lapse in funding.
segments.tr: Trong thực tế, các nhà lập pháp thường xuyên tụt lại so với tiến độ, dựa vào các nghị quyết tiếp tục tạm thời hoặc các gói omnibus vào phút chót để tránh một khoảng trống trong tài trợ.

segments.src: This year appears to be following that familiar pattern: with the House and Senate now out of session for several weeks, negotiators have limited floor time left to reconcile competing spending priorities between the two chambers before the deadline arrives.
segments.tr: Năm nay dường như đang theo sau mô hình quen thuộc đó: với Hạ viện và Thượng viện hiện đã ngừng họp trong vài tuần, các nhà đàm phán có thời gian sàn giao dịch hạn chế để điều hòa các ưu tiên chi tiêu cạnh tranh giữa hai viện trước khi hạn chót đến.

segments.src: Congressional aides describe the current standoff as centering on familiar sticking points — the overall size of discretionary spending, funding levels for border security and immigration enforcement agencies, and policy riders attached to individual bills.
segments.tr: Các trợ lý Quốc Hội mô tả bế tắc hiện tại là tập trung vào các điểm bất đồng quen thuộc — quy mô tổng thể chi tiêu tùy ý, mức tài trợ cho an ninh biên giới và các cơ quan thực thi nhập cư, và các điều khoản chính sách được gắn vào các dự luật riêng lẻ.

segments.src: None of these disagreements are new, but they carry extra weight this year given how disruptive the last funding lapse turned out to be.
segments.tr: Không có bất kỳ bất đồ nào trong số này là mới, nhưng chúng mang lại trọng lượng bổ sung năm nay do cách mà khoảng trống tài trợ cuối cùng tỏ ra gây nhiều rối loạn.

segments.src: ## Why the Last Shutdown Still Looms Large
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Sự Tắt Cửa Cuối Cùng Vẫn Còn Ý Nghĩa Lớn

segments.src: Earlier this year, a funding impasse specifically affecting the Department of Homeland Security stretched to 76 days, becoming the longest shutdown on record for that agency.
segments.tr: Vào đầu năm nay, một bế tắc tài chính cụ thể ảnh hưởng đến Bộ An ninh Nội địa kéo dài 76 ngày, trở thành sự tắt cửa lâu nhất được ghi nhận cho cơ quan đó.

segments.src: During the lapse, hundreds of thousands of federal employees were furloughed or required to work without pay, immigration courts and case processing slowed significantly, and routine agency functions were delayed for weeks after funding was eventually restored.
segments.tr: Trong thời gian gián đoạn, hàng trăm nghìn nhân viên liên bang bị chấm dứt tạm thời hoặc bị yêu cầu làm việc mà không trả lương, các tòa án nhập cư và xử lý hồ sơ chậm lại đáng kể, và các chức năng thường quy của cơ quan bị trì hoãn trong vài tuần sau khi tài trợ được khôi phục cuối cùng.

segments.src: That experience has left both congressional leaders and federal agencies wary of a repeat.
segments.tr: Trải nghiệm đó đã để lại cho cả lãnh đạo Quốc Hội và các cơ quan liên bang nghi ngại về một lần lặp lại.

segments.src: Agency officials have reportedly begun contingency planning earlier than usual this year, and some lawmakers have publicly floated the idea of a short-term continuing resolution to buy additional negotiating time past September 30, rather than risk another prolonged lapse.
segments.tr: Các quan chức cơ quan được cho là đã bắt đầu lập kế hoạch ứng phó sớm hơn bình thường năm nay, và một số nhà lập pháp đã công khai đưa ra ý tưởng về một nghị quyết tiếp tục ngắn hạn để mua thêm thời gian đàm phán quá hạn 30 tháng 9, thay vì rủi ro một khoảng trống kéo dài khác.

segments.src: Whether such a stopgap can pass both chambers, however, remains an open question, since continuing resolutions themselves require bipartisan support and have occasionally become bargaining chips in broader funding disputes.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, liệu một giải pháp tạm thời như vậy có thể được cả hai viện thông qua hay không vẫn là một câu hỏi mở, vì các nghị quyết tiếp tục bản thân chúng yêu cầu sự hỗ trợ của cả hai đảng và thỉnh thoảng trở thành các tấm thẻ chiến lược trong các tranh chấp tài trợ rộng hơn.

segments.src: ## What Happens When Recess Ends
segments.tr: ## Điều Gì Xảy Ra Khi Kỳ Nghỉ Kết Thúc

segments.src: When lawmakers return to Washington in September, they will have only a handful of legislative days before the fiscal year ends.
segments.tr: Khi các nhà lập pháp quay lại Washington vào tháng 9, họ sẽ chỉ có một số ít ngày lập pháp trước khi năm tài khóa kết thúc.

segments.src: Congressional leadership will need to decide whether to push for a full-year omnibus package, pass individual appropriations bills piecemeal, or rely once again on a short-term continuing resolution to prevent a lapse while talks continue.
segments.tr: Lãnh đạo Quốc Hội sẽ cần phải quyết định xem có nên đẩy mạnh một gói omnibus toàn năm, thông qua các dự luật bổ sung cấp kinh phí riêng lẻ từng phần, hoặc lại dựa vào một nghị quyết tiếp tục ngắn hạn để ngăn chặn một khoảng trống trong khi các cuộc đàm phán tiếp tục.

segments.src: Each path carries tradeoffs: a rushed omnibus can invite criticism over process, piecemeal bills are time-consuming to pass individually, and repeated short-term patches have drawn frustration from members in both parties who argue the approach makes long-term planning difficult for federal agencies.
segments.tr: Mỗi con đường đều có sự đánh đổi: một omnibus vội vàng có thể gây ra chỉ trích về quá trình, các dự luật từng phần tốn nhiều thời gian để thông qua riêng lẻ, và các bản vá ngắn hạn lặp lại đã gây ra sự thất vọng từ các thành viên trong cả hai đảng những người cho rằng cách tiếp cận này làm cho việc lập kế hoạch dài hạn khó khăn đối với các cơ quan liên bang.

segments.src: ## The Stakes for Federal Operations and the Public
segments.tr: ## Những Cược Cuộc Cho Hoạt Động Liên Bang và Công Chúng

segments.src: A funding lapse does not affect every part of government equally.
segments.tr: Một khoảng trống tài trợ không ảnh hưởng đến mọi phần của chính phủ như nhau.

segments.src: Programs deemed essential, such as active-duty military operations, air traffic control, and law enforcement, typically continue, though employees may go unpaid until funding is restored.
segments.tr: Các chương trình được coi là cần thiết, chẳng hạn như hoạt động quân sự tích cực, kiểm soát không lưu và thực thi pháp luật, thường tiếp tục, mặc dù nhân viên có thể không được trả lương cho đến khi tài trợ được khôi phục.

segments.src: Other functions — including some regulatory reviews, permitting processes, and administrative services — can slow or pause entirely.
segments.tr: Các chức năng khác — bao gồm một số đánh giá quy định, quy trình cấp phép và dịch vụ hành chính — có thể chậm lại hoặc tạm dừng hoàn toàn.

segments.src: Federal contractors, national parks, and agencies that rely heavily on discretionary funding are often among the most visibly affected during an extended lapse.
segments.tr: Các nhà thầu liên bang, công viên quốc gia và các cơ quan dựa vào tài trợ tùy ý thường là những cơ quan bị ảnh hưởng nhiều nhất trong thời gian gián đoạn kéo dài.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts have also noted that repeated shutdown threats carry costs beyond the furlough period itself, including delayed federal payments, reduced consumer and business confidence during periods of uncertainty, and administrative costs associated with winding down and restarting agency operations.
segments.tr: Các nhà kinh tế và nhà phân tích ngân sách cũng đã lưu ý rằng các mối đe dọa tắt cửa lặp lại mang lại chi phí vượt quá kỳ nghỉ tạm thời chính nó, bao gồm thanh toán liên bang bị trì hoãn, sự tự tin của người tiêu dùng và kinh doanh giảm trong các giai đoạn không chắc chắn, và chi phí hành chính liên quan đến việc đóng cửa và khởi động lại hoạt động cơ quan.

segments.src: The Congressional Budget Office and Government Accountability Office have both published analyses of prior shutdowns highlighting these lingering effects, which can persist for weeks after funding is restored.
segments.tr: Văn phòng Ngân sách Quốc Hội và Văn phòng Trách Nhiệm Hành Chính Chính Phủ đều đã công bố các phân tích về các sự tắt cửa trước đó nhấn mạnh những tác động kéo dài này, điều này có thể kéo dài trong vài tuần sau khi tài trợ được khôi phục.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in September
segments.tr: ## Những Điều Cần Theo Dõi Vào Tháng 9

segments.src: As the September 30 deadline approaches, key signals to watch will include whether appropriations committees release updated bill text before recess ends, whether leadership in either chamber signals openness to a short-term continuing resolution, and how the White House and congressional leaders characterize their opening negotiating positions.
segments.tr: Khi hạn chót ngày 30 tháng 9 đến gần, các tín hiệu chính cần theo dõi sẽ bao gồm liệu các ủy ban bổ sung cấp kinh phí có phát hành văn bản dự luật cập nhật trước khi kỳ nghỉ kết thúc, liệu lãnh đạo trong một trong hai viện có tín hiệu cởi mở đối với một nghị quyết tiếp tục ngắn hạn, và cách mà Nhà Trắng và các lãnh đạo Quốc Hội mô tả vị trí đàm phán mở đầu của họ.

segments.src: Given the scale of disruption caused by the prior 76-day shutdown, both sides have incentives to avoid a repeat — but with the same underlying disagreements still unresolved, the coming weeks will determine whether Congress can act before the clock runs out again.
segments.tr: Với quy mô xáo trộn do sự tắt cửa kéo dài 76 ngày trước gây ra, cả hai bên đều có động lực tránh một lần lặp lại — nhưng với những bất đồng cơ bản vẫn còn chưa được giải quyết, những tuần tới sẽ xác định liệu Quốc Hội có thể hành động trước khi thời gian hết hạn lại hay không.
